capabilities: make wikilinks containing a folder respect the default-location setting
create notes relative to the linking note's folder for ./ and ../ links
block link clicks that would create files outside the vault
remove the misleading Folder already exists error on repeated clicks
document behavior with a clickable demo vault
extras: Documentation is itself a demo vault of clickable cases (viewable on GitHub, shipped with each release, or opened via a command); beta versions install via BRAT; debug messages are hidden by default.
intentEvidence: This plugin makes the first two obey the setting you configured
problem: In stock Obsidian, where a clicked unresolved link creates its note depends unpredictably on the link's shape, sometimes placing files at the wrong spot or even outside the vault.

relations.evidence: Folder prompt on missing-link click; recent folders; drops written folder paths
Creates unresolved wikilink targets/folders when leaving a line; shortens unique links
Command creates missing targets in a note/folder; folder/template rules
Own @-triggered suggester; optional template; creates its chosen targets
One-click creation of unresolved links through Dataview

summary: Fixes new-note creation from wiki links so subfolder and relative links respect the default location setting and never create files outside the vault.
